slides.headline: Classification is *not writing*
slides.subhead: Routing, triage, relevance, scoring, qualification. Every one has a closed answer set, and teams pay generation prices for all of them because a chat model was the only tool on the shelf.

slides.headline: One has a closed answer set. *One does not.*
slides.body: Does this message convey urgency has a bounded answer. Analyse this and determine the best course of action does not, and should never be asked the same way.

slides.kicker: FOUR RULES THAT OUTLIVE ANY VENDOR
slides.headline: What to do *instead*
items: Ask what a knowledgeable person answers in one second
Select, never generate. Build the candidates in code
Threshold on confidence, not on the answer
Batch every question that shares the same state

slides.headline: Batching *13 questions* into one call
slides.body: cheaper, and 9.6x faster than asking them separately, with identical answers. TypeSafe's own figure, not an independent test.

slides.headline: This is a *de-scoping*, not a replacement
Go count the decision steps in your own pipeline
slides.body: Most of them are classification wearing a generation invoice. You will not know how many until you walk it once.
slides.source: Figures are TypeSafe's own published measurements, vendor run
